headline: US Tightens AI Chip Controls, China Advances Domestic AI, Fed Minutes Show Inflation Fears
summary: US intensifies AI server export controls, seizing $400M in Nvidia equipment, while China pushes its own AI GPU development. Fed and ECB minutes are expected to reveal ongoing inflation concerns, even as market rate hike bets fade. IG Group shares plunged 27% after slashing 2026 guidance.

bullets.lead: US intensifies crackdown on AI server smuggling to China.

segments.text: US authorities arrested individuals suspected of smuggling $400 million worth of Nvidia AI servers to China, highlighting ongoing export control enforcement.

bullets.lead: China advances its domestic AI chip capabilities.

segments.text: Biren is preparing its BR20X chip, aiming to challenge Nvidia in the AI GPU market and reduce China's reliance on foreign technology.

segments.text: Elon Musk and Jensen Huang anticipate China closing the lithography gap by 2030, indicating a long-term challenge to Western dominance in chip manufacturing.

sources.title: Elon Musk, Jensen Huang see China closing lithography gap by 2030

segments.text: Rumors suggest TSMC is exploring participation in Terafab, with potential expansion into Texas to support this initiative, possibly involving collaboration with Intel.
